 ORDER

Petitioner's contention is that the order dated 26.02.2018 passed by the Additional Chief Secretary,
Water Resources Department is arbitrary and unjust.
There is no justification for issuing such order which is totally without any basis.
Admittedly, reply of the State Government is silent on this aspect.
No reply is furnished that under which provision of law impugned order (Annexure P-8) has been issued by the Additional Chief Secretary.

Since reply is silent then, as per the principles of pleadings for want of specific denial, it is treated to be an acceptance by the State Government that the Order (Annexure P-8) is arbitrary,
illegal and without jurisdiction.

State authorities are not authorized to issue any instructions contrary to the statutory provisions contained in the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 or The Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency In Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency In Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Any instructions issued contrary to the statutory provisions is liable to be quashed and is hereby quashed.
Accordingly, this petition is allowed.
Impugned order (Annexure P-8) is quashed.

it is directed that the authority shall recalculate the compensation as contained in Annexure P-2 after taking into consideration the physical condition of the land and the assets which have been created on the land be it a house or trees or tube-well etc. as per the terms and conditions of the Land Acquisition Act.
Let this exercise be completed within 60 days from the date of receipt of the certified copy of the order.

Respondent/State shall also bear cost of this litigation for the petitioner as petitioner is put to inconvenience due to arbitrary administrative order passed by the then Addl. Chief Secretary to Government of M.P. which is quantified as Rs.10,000/-.
